findings.location: Testimony, from “I also found a second century article” through the account of the Mexican couple; and final paragraph, wherever “نقاب” is used for the head covering
findings.source_quote: “all of the women wore a cloth veiling on their heads”; “my wife began to veil her head”; “since we have begun the practice of veiling”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “نقاب” in these references with wording for a cloth head covering, such as “سر ڈھانپنے کا کپڑا” or “سرپوش,” and adjust the surrounding phrases accordingly. For example, “کپڑے کا نقاب پہنتی تھیں” → “کپڑے سے سر ڈھانپتی تھیں.”
findings.translation_quote: “تمام عورتیں اپنے سروں پر کپڑے کا نقاب پہنتی تھیں”؛ “میری بیوی نے سر پر نقاب لینا شروع کر دیا”؛ “ہم نے نقاب لینے کا عمل شروع کیا ہے”
